name: Freshservice
description: Connect your own Freshservice ITSM account to manage Tickets (Incidents & Service Requests), Problems, Changes, Releases, Assets (CMDB), and Knowledge Base articles through the Freshservice v2 REST API.

tools.name: connect_freshservice
tools.description: Connect your own Freshservice account by saving your domain and API key, after checking they actually work.

api_key.description: Freshservice account API key (Profile Settings > API Key).
api_key.title: Api Key

tools.name: disconnect_freshservice
tools.description: Disconnect a Freshservice account: deletes the saved domain/API key.

connection_id.description: Saved Freshservice connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Freshservice accounts.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets (Incidents and Service Requests) in the connected Freshservice account, optionally filtered by a Freshservice filter query.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Optional Freshservice filter query, e.g. "status:2" or "priority:3".
query.title: Query

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Read one ticket in full by id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new ticket (Incident or Service Request).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing ticket. Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_problems
tools.description: List problems on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_problem
tools.description: Create a new problem record.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_problem
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing problem.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List change requests on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_change
tools.description: Create a new change request.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_change
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing change request.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List releases on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a new release record.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing release.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_knowledge_articles
tools.description: List Knowledge Base articles on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_requesters
tools.description: List requesters (end users who raise tickets) on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (support staff) on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_table
tools.description: List records from any Freshservice v2 API path -- a generic passthrough for endpoints not covered by typed wrappers.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Exact Freshservice v2 API path, e.g. '/tickets' or '/agents'.
path.title: Path

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Create a new record on any Freshservice v2 API path -- a generic passthrough for endpoints not covered by typed wrappers.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Exact Freshservice v2 API path, e.g. '/tickets'.
path.title: Path

values.description: Field name/value pairs for the request body.
values.title: Values

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Update a record on any Freshservice v2 API path -- a generic passthrough for endpoints not covered by typed wrappers.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Exact Freshservice v2 API path, e.g. '/tickets'.
path.title: Path

values.description: Field name/value pairs for the request body.
values.title: Values

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Permanently delete a record from any Freshservice v2 API path. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Exact Freshservice v2 API path including the record id, e.g. '/tickets/123'.
path.title: Path

tools.name: audit_instance_health
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected Freshservice account: open tickets/problems/changes/releases.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List Configuration Items (CMDB assets) on the connected Freshservice account.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Read one asset (Configuration Item) in full by display id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Freshservice connection ID. Omit to use the first connected account.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: freshservice_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Freshservice accounts and encrypted API keys. Managed only through connect_freshservice and disconnect_freshservice.

pricing.notes: Standard platform scale {0, 8, 16, 20, 40}. 0 = access setup and harmless discovery. 8 = read/list/search. 16 = standard single mutation/CRUD. 20 = bulk or heavy audit operation.
